extraction: Team agent Kanban card schema: card = {id, title, owner_agent, status, dependencies, acceptance_criteria, artifacts, created, updated}. Status: backlog → building → verifying → applying → re-verifying → done. Maps to our engine Kanban: each engine = card. Engine moves building→verifying. Verdict moves verifying→applying (writes fix spec). Miss moves applying→re-verifying (applies patch). Verdict moves re-verifying→done (PASS) or back to applying (FAIL → fix-loop round 2).
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether Kanban card schema formalizes engine pipeline state machine
